movers.headline: closes a **Rs 49.50 crore qualified institutions placement**, allotting 49.50 crore shares at Re 1, of which **Minerva Ventures Fund takes 9.08%**

wins MeitY approval under the Electronic Components Manufacturing Scheme for a **Rs 1,020.65 crore capital investment** at Rajkot, with a capex incentive of up to 25%. The spend runs **over five years**
completes the purchase of **51.13% of Steel Infra Solutions for Rs 626.40 crore**, part cash and part share swap, making the heavy-fabrication company a subsidiary
receives an **additional Q4 allocation of 20,740 kilolitres of ethanol** for the oil marketing companies in Assam and Madhya Pradesh, which it values at **Rs 146.66 crore**

wins, with Indrajaal Autonomous Defense Systems, a **Rs 145 crore Ministry of Home Affairs border-security order** for Indrajaal Ranger anti-drone patrol vehicles; the release does not split the consortium
wins an **additional ethanol allocation of 1.98 crore litres** valued at **Rs 140 crore**, through wholly owned Modi Biotech, for supply to the oil marketing companies until October 2026
receives an **NHAI letter of acceptance worth Rs 80.17 crore** to run user-fee collection at the **Palayam plaza on NH-44 in Tamil Nadu**, on a BOT basis
approves a **Rs 44.88 crore preferential issue of 16,02,870 shares at Rs 280** to a named list of allottees, priced off a valuation report struck to a **14 August relevant date**

order_wins: **Larsen & Toubro** — an **Ultra-Mega offshore EPCIC award in the Middle East** for multiple offshore facilities, a band its own published order-classification table places **above Rs 15,000 crore**, with no point value and no client named.

**Om Infra** — a **Rs 29.01 crore supplementary letter of award from Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam (Rural)** covering repairs and three years of operation and maintenance on **306 solar-powered water units in Unnao** _(~3.5% of mcap)_.

**Drone Destination** — a **three-year work order from Indian Potash** to run 34 agriculture drones across Gujarat and Odisha on an acreage-based spraying model, with the drones supplied by Indian Potash and no contract value stated.

**Sigma Advanced Systems** — the same release carries a **separate order of about Rs 10 crore** for urban police use of the Indrajaal Ranger, which the company puts with the border award at roughly **Rs 155 crore** of orders announced.

**Ahasolar Technologies** — a consultancy work order from **NLC India Renewables** covering a 250 MW/500 MWh battery storage project, a 50 MW solar project at Mine-II and a 25 MW/150 MWh storage project at Neyveli, with no value stated.

**Abhishek Integrations** — ranked **L1 rather than awarded** on a **Rs 3.15 crore**, 24-month electrical maintenance contract for the Airports Authority of India at Kolkata's NSCBI Airport _(~13.8% of mcap)_.

**Happy Square Outsourcing** — a two-year staffing work order from **Bharat Petroleum of approximately Rs 1.95 crore**, inclusive of all taxes, which the company expects to earn as revenue over the contract period.
**Sharika Enterprises** — a **Rs 1.78 crore purchase order from LS Cable India** for 24F and 48F OPGW cable, to be executed by 14 September _(~2.2% of mcap)_.

**Focus Lighting and Fixtures** — completes the **Kankaria Lake lighting project in Ahmedabad** for the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, an award it first disclosed on 27 November 2025, with no value stated.

**Kernex Microsystems** — of the **3,024-unit CLW-II order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, 1,360 units are supplied**; it plans to dispatch the balance 1,664 by November 2026 and commission them by 5 February 2027.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Containe Technologies** — fixes the terms of a **Rs 20.98 crore rights issue**, 1,39,88,000 shares at Rs 15 on a **two-for-one entitlement**, record date 21 August, open from 31 August to 25 September _(~134% of mcap)_.

**SPR Auto Technologies** (formerly Shriram Pistons & Rings) — opens a qualified institutions placement at a **floor price of Rs 4,438.20 a share**, with a discount of up to 5% permitted and no issue size stated in the pages read.
**Netweb Technologies** — opens its own qualified institutions placement the same evening at a **floor price of Rs 4,885.90 a share**, again with no issue size stated in the pages read.
**Gamco** — approves a **Rs 21.53 crore preferential issue of up to 43,05,960 shares at Rs 50** to non-promoter allottees, subject to members' approval _(~8.2% of mcap)_.
**Atal Realtech** — approves a **rights issue of not more than Rs 16 crore** and the draft letter of offer, with the price, entitlement ratio and record date still to be decided _(~3.6% of mcap)_.
**Kshitij Polyline** — obtains the rights-entitlement ISIN for the **rights issue of not more than Rs 29.34 crore** its board approved on 13 August _(~63% of mcap)_.
equity_allotments: **Lloyds Engineering Works** — allots **7,00,42,458 shares at Rs 71.25, Rs 499.05 crore**, to Steel Infra Solutions' shareholders **for consideration other than cash** — the swap leg of the acquisition above, so no capital enters the company.

**Srestha Finvest** — converts **15,25,79,365 of the 85,30,00,000 warrants** it allotted in February 2025 into equity at Re 1 plus a 5 paise premium, a past-warrant conversion rather than new capital.
m_and_a: **Mastek** — completes the sale of a **1,57,233 sq ft commercial building at Mahindra World City SEZ, Chennai, for Rs 60 crore** to Caresoft Mobility, received in two tranches _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Transchem** — buys **100% of Greshma Shares and Stocks for Rs 25.91 crore**, 1,55,16,000 shares at Rs 16.70 each under a share purchase agreement executed today, making the broker a wholly owned subsidiary _(~6.6% of mcap)_.

**NDTV** — signs an asset purchase agreement for the **GoodTimes channel for up to Rs 18 crore** cash and advertising inventory, from joint venture Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting, subject to Information and Broadcasting Ministry approval.

**Manipal Health Enterprises** — signs a business transfer agreement for the whole of **Kinder Women's Hospital and Fertility Centre, Bengaluru**, which turned over **Rs 20.75 crore** to March 2026; the consideration is not stated.

**Greaves Cotton** — completes its **multi-tranche acquisition of Excel Controlinkage**, buying the remaining 20% through the secondary route to reach 100% with effect from 13 August, with no value stated.
**Varun Beverages** — completes the **merger of Twizza into The Beverage Company** in South Africa, first disclosed on 2 July, so Twizza ceases to be a step-down subsidiary.

**CEAT** — converts **US$24.5 million of an US$80 million inter-company loan** into 1,27,88,094 shares of CEAT OHT Lanka at LKR 642.67 each, which moves no funds and leaves the Sri Lankan unit wholly owned.
**V R Infraspace** — completes the purchase of a further **10% of Daxon Realty at Rs 17.88 a share**, taking its holding in the subsidiary to **66%**.
**Man Infraconstruction** — acquires additional partnership interest in **MICL Properties LLP** to reach **50%**, an associate with Rs 1 lakh of capital and nil turnover in FY26.
capex_core: **Shilp Gravures** — approves **Rs 5.71 crore of plant and machinery in Karnataka**, plus Rs 1 crore of commencement costs, for a facility that at full utilisation adds **over 18,000 gravure cylinders a year** to 94,000 today, funded from internal accruals.

**EFC (I)** — leases an entire **95,897 sq ft A+ building at Koregaon Park Annex, Pune** for five years, adding 2,000-plus managed-office seats at a stated **revenue potential of more than Rs 70 crore**.
business_updates: **Results season** — **111 companies filed results or earnings-call material** (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Associated Alcohols & Breweries** — receives an **additional allocation of 87.4 lakh litres of ethanol** from BPCL, and is the only one of the day's three distillers to name the cause: a **Supreme Court order on the Q4 ESY 2025-26 allocation methodology**.

**Wardwizard Foods and Beverages** — June-quarter revenue up **29% to Rs 17.03 crore**, total income **Rs 17.65 crore**, EBITDA margin **19.90%** against 2.78%, and a **Rs 1.31 crore profit** against a year-ago loss.
distress_risk: **Oberoi Realty — a win, not a loss.** Haryana's town-planning director rejected Advance India Projects' representation on 13 August, holding the **Three Sixty North licence and change of developer intact**, so the High Court's restriction on further allotments has **ceased to be operative**.
other_notable: **Premier Energies** — Crisil **upgrades the long-term ratings of the company and three subsidiaries to A+/Positive from A/Positive**, and enhances the rated bank facilities of the parent to Rs 300 crore from Rs 50 crore.

**IIFL Finance** — Fitch **upgrades the long-term issuer default rating to BB- from B+**, outlook stable, upgrading senior secured debt and the medium-term note programme with it and withdrawing the recovery rating.

**SEDEMAC Mechatronics** — India Ratings **upgrades its bank-loan facilities to IND A/Stable**, affirming the short-term rating at IND A1 and assigning the same to a further INR 1,018.6 million of facilities.
**Robust Hotels** — Crisil **upgrades Rs 170 crore of bank facilities to BBB+/Stable from BBB/Stable**, and the short-term rating to A2 from A3+.
